media:group.media:description:

media:group.media:title: r:talk​ Renault E-Space Concept : secrets behind its name
media:group.media:description: from 1984 Renault Espace to Renault E-Space Concept, the link between heritage and innovation.​​ ​​ Sylvia dos Santos, naming manager, looks back at the origin of the name of this new concept car, a worthy successor to the iconic 1984 MPV.​​ ​​ join us at Paris Motor Show from 12th to 18th October, Paris Expo Porte de Versailles, hall 6.​​ ​​ more info: https://bit.ly/Renault_E-Space_Concept
